project_info.target_audience: Retail chain finance and store-operations staff performing opening-stock migration from legacy ERP or RetailCLIQ systems

layout_and_density.card_style: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5
layout_and_density.table_style: w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse divide-y divide-slate-200
layout_and_density.header_style: sticky top-0 z-30 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
layout_and_density.sticky_stepper_style: sticky top-[57px] z-20 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 py-3 px-6 shadow-xs

login_page.description: Tenant login with tenant ID, store/branch scope selection, username/password, and system status indicator

dashboard.description: Enterprise overview with counter metrics (Total Batches, Rows Posted Today, Overall Error Rate, Active Staging Jobs) + Batch History Table with status filters and quick actions

new_import_wizard.description: 5-step gate-locked stepper: 1. Configure (ERP Source, Store Target, Mode) -> 2. Upload CSV/Excel -> 3. Validate (Schema & Sanity checks) -> 4. Gate (Pre-flight Check Panel) -> 5. Post & Reconcile (Chunk processing progress)

batch_detail_page.description: Comprehensive batch breakdown with header summary, progress meter, chunk status grid (batch divided into processing chunks), and Phase 2 post-reconciliation audit status

validation_error_viewer.description: Filterable/sortable error log table with inline expandable rows showing exact row number, field name, legacy value, error reason, and downloadable CSV button

preflight_check_panel.description: Gate step pre-flight validator running automated checks (Store SKU Mapping, Negative Stock Guards, Ledger Mapping, Legacy Batch Duplication) returning PASS/FAIL/WARN/PHASE2 status badges before enabling Post action

interactive_rules.destructive_actions: All destructive actions (e.g. Rollback Batch, Cancel Import, Delete Draft Staging) MUST require typed confirmation modal (e.g. prompt user to type 'ROLLBACK' or the batch code like 'BAT-2026-0042').
interactive_rules.gate_locking: Wizard steps 3, 4, and 5 are strictly gate-locked until preceding step returns PASS or user explicitly acknowledges WARN conditions.
interactive_rules.hover_states: Interactive table rows must have hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors. Buttons must have explicit hover background and text color contrasts.
interactive_rules.toast_notifications: Use Sonner toast notifications for async validation completions, batch posting triggers, error exports, and confirmation steps.

universal_guidelines.test_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
universal_guidelines.file_type: JavaScript (.js) components only in src/components/ and src/pages/.
universal_guidelines.icons: Use lucide-react icons for all UI indicators (CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, ArrowRight, UploadCloud, RefreshCw, FileSpreadsheet, ShieldAlert, Database, Layers).
